sections.title: Animus Adept Rang 5 · 17 Glyphen
sections.markdown:
Campaign virtual rank **5**. This conversion advances Vesper's established glyph engine/rank features; it does not independently grant the prestige class's separate maneuver/stance progression beyond her campaign Martial Training track.

Operational values:

- initial Animus on first own turn: **9** = 1 base + IM7 +1 Runic Singularity;
- **+2** at start of each later own turn through Runic Singularity;
- +1 at round end if Vesper initiated at least one maneuver that round;
- glyph cost 1 Animus;
- range **55 ft**;
- duration **8 rounds** unless the glyph ends earlier;
- glyph save DC **22** where relevant;
- cast as swift, or once/round as free after Vesper hits with a martial strike;
- same glyph does not stack or refresh itself.

### Runic Singularity — rank5
- Cast one eligible known glyph **as part of initiating a boost or changing stances**, still spending a legal **1 Animus** and obeying the target, range, and effect gates. No bonus turn, no free unlimited glyph; standard separate post-strike glyph trigger remains as previously.
- Initial Animus at start of first own turn becomes **9** (base 1+IM7 plus the rank5 additional +1 every turn); begin each later own turn **+2** instead of +1, additionally +1 after a round where she actually initiated a maneuver.
- Virtual Animus Adept package ends after rank5 per current WotW progression.

### Mass Martial Glyphs - retained rank4 feature

- **Full-round action**.
- Cast one known martial glyph on up to **7 allies within 30 ft** (IM +7).
- Normal glyph cost/application rules apply through this rank feature as established.

### Known glyphs — 17

Retained basic glyphs:

1. **Elemental Shield:** energy resistance **12** to Vesper's active element/energy.
2. **Ghost Eating Blade:** target weapons gain ghost touch.
3. **Ghost Armor:** target armor/shield gain ghost touch.
4. **Deflective Armor:** +3 natural armor, normal nonstacking rules.
5. **Shadowmeld:** 20% concealment.
6. **Elemental Weapon:** attacks deal +1d6 chosen active elemental damage.
7. **Evasive Armor:** next successful Reflex save against a partial-on-success effect instead gives no effect, then glyph ends.
8. **Blinding Blade:** next qualifying hit forces Reflex **DC 22** or blind 1 round; glyph ends after the attempt.

Retained rank-3 advanced glyphs:

9. **Spirit Stride:** recipient may teleport **25 ft as a free action** to an unoccupied space it can see; line of sight required, line of effect not required; glyph ends after one teleport.
10. **Illusionary State:** mirror image at effective CL **11**, **1d4+4 images**; duration up to **8 rounds** and ends earlier when images are destroyed.
11. **Wind Speed:** haste benefits for **8 rounds**: one additional attack at highest BAB during a full attack, +1 attack, +1 dodge AC, +1 Reflex, +30-ft enhancement movement capped normally.

New rank-4 advanced glyphs:

12. **Death Shield:** resistance **11 to negative energy** (equal to current IL 12) and +4 on saves against energy drain and negative-energy effects.
13. **Hardened Armor:** **DR 5/adamantine**.
14. **Spiritual Anchor:** target is affected as dimensional anchor for the glyph duration. If applied through the once/round post-strike free cast, Vesper must have hit that target with the strike; if cast separately, she must hit the target with a ranged touch attack. It blocks dimensional travel, not ordinary incorporeal movement through walls/floors.

**New rank5 master glyphs**, each cost 1 Animus, typical range55 ft, duration up to8 rounds where appropriate, save DC22 if relevant:

15. **Dispelling Burn:** targeted greater dispel magic at effective caster level11, roll **1d20+12** against 11+effect caster level. Damage **1d4 per spell level actually dispelled**, only for effects actually removed; target selection, spell prioritization and dispel limits stay real. Not blanket antimagic.
16. **Drowning Curse:** target **nauseated and unable to speak/verbal-cast** while active; at the **start of each own turn** may attempt **Fort DC22** to resist the effect **for that turn** (not necessarily terminate the glyph). Not a universal defeat of immunity.
17. **Fortified Heart:** recipient **immune to critical hits and sneak attacks** while the glyph remains active; ordinary damage, nonprecision riders and attack hits still apply.

sections.title: Talente
sections.markdown:
- **Power Attack:** campaign-granted, not a normal feat slot.
- **Noble Scion: Scion of War:** initiative keyed to CHA.
- **Hurtful:** swift-action extra melee attack after Valeria successfully demoralizes a melee-reachable foe; the shaken effect from that demoralization ends immediately if the Hurtful attack fails to damage it under the established campaign cache.
- **Cornugon Smash:** free-action demoralize attempt when Power Attack deals damage.
- Variant Multiclass Cavalier has consumed normal feat slots at levels 3 and 7.
- **Campaign house rule for future progression:** VMC Tactician at level 11 and Greater Tactician at level 19 are replaced by ordinary feat slots to avoid party-wide teamwork-feat state overhead. The level-15 greater order ability remains normal.
- **New level9 feat Furious Focus** (player-approved; first two-handed Power Attack attack each round ignores its -3 penalty). Existing VMC feat costs already paid.

### Skills — four new level9 ranks

Level9 gives four ranks including favored-class bonus, assigned to the same four maxed skills 8→9:

| Skill | Ranks | Total |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Intimidate** | **9** | **+19** ordinary |
| **Diplomacy** | **9** | **+19** |
| **Sense Motive** | **9** | **+12** |
| **Stealth** | **9** | **+13** with actual Shadow plate or unarmored |

Stealth **+13 with actual Shadow full plate** is net of -5 Armor Check Penalty and +5 competence Shadow property. It matters for surprise/positioning. If the armor is removed, the Shadow competence bonus disappears while the armor's -5 ACP also disappears, yielding +13 unarmored. No skill rank was traded for +1 HP.

**Demoralize** with retained VMC Air Grievances at level9: ordinary Intimidate+19 plus Air Grievances+4 = **+23**; against living within Aura of Obedience10ft, +4 morale =› **+27**. Check actual targeting, immunity, proximity and stacking on the action.

**Shadow Armor is completed and worn since15Apr.** Its +5 competence Stealth bonus counters, but does not erase, the armor's -5 Armor Check Penalty. Both are already included in the level9 Stealth+13 profile.
